@Mets A lot of talk about respect in this thread. I have a great deal of respect for our public servants, especially our EMTs, nurses and doctors and MTA workers. They've been thru hell. 

I don't have respect for abuse of power and a culture of coverup.  #BlackLivesMatter

Will this get a tenth of the coverage that Chicago gets?

Will conservative media even cover it at all?

We already know the answers.

#BlackLivesMatter
